## What's New in v1.6.0 — Jetpack Compose Expressive UI

### 🎨 Brand New Expressive Jetpack Compose UI
- **100% Jetpack Compose UI Engine:** Replaced legacy XML layouts and preference screens with a modern, high-performance Jetpack Compose architecture.
- **Signature Runtime Pulse Command Center:** Integrated an animated radial health ring (98%) and top emerald telemetry status strip.
- **Bento Grid Layout:** Intelligent 1-column (phone) and 2-column (tablet) bento card layout.
- **Subtle Frosted Acrylic Surfaces:** Elevated 24dp rounded cards with subtle 1dp whisper strokes.
- **Expressive Micro-Interactions & Switches:** Tactile scale-down press feedback (0.97f) and 180° rotating checkmark toggle switches.
- **Floating Morphing Navigation Bar:** Decoupled floating navigation bar featuring smooth pill indicator transitions.
